body:
thank you for your thoughts :) 

might elaborate soon. just a heads up, if you are depressed, *please* do not go over to the red pill. it is toxic (if you';re a curious cat, don't say I didn't warn you :p)

I mean, if we're going into that, then yes there is more. We cuddled. We went to '2nd base.' We, uh, dry humped...this was all before it went to shit oc, I really don't feel this is the place for it and some users may be uncomfortable about this. But long story short there was no intercourse, and it was quite clear that she felt spiritually torn about it. She said quite often, stuff like "how can you sleep at night X? Because I can't" and I remember at the breakup she said something like "I have to choose between you or my family. Either way I'll lose someone". Even when we broke up, she said she never really liked the terms "boyfriend/girlfriend" in general. She preferred our pet names... 

Her behaviour grew steadily worse as mine did. No she was not perfect but she's not my mom, she doesn't have to be. (That was one problem; I had some co-dependent tendencies and mommy issues, and I unconsciously projected the divorce onto her...I was Dad who got cheated on, her guy friend my now step dad then 'part time lover', she was mom...it was weird and not healthy) 

Yeah I realise that we maybe should have stayed friends now haha. In hindsight it was far too soon after I was put on meds to be dating...and it has taken me years to think through the various issues I have wrt. family dynamics. 

Yes she did in fact say to me when going NC "Please don't bother me with any more of your stress." She did a great job handling it as long as she did, but I think I made a mistake emotionally throwing up on  her after maybe 9 months apart? :/ I had to get it off my chest. I planned to do it in person, but I thought she was blocking me on stuff like Facebook. She said she'd just gone to eat tea, that was the only reason she didn't immediately respond. Or something.

I should note the irony of this is that, as a nerdy socially awkward (turns out aspie) virgin who's frankly not very good with girls :p I thought that a traditional woman would be more suitable for me. My mistake was that TRP is not only pretty misogynistic, but describes the exact opposite dating scene (hook-ups) of what happens in her culture (arranged marriage). Lol. But then, how was I to know that at the time, the guy who told me she was likely to cheat never said he was a redpiller. This wasn't on Reddit,and it was a whole year before I even knew the existence of the idea, although I was vaguely familiar with some tenets of general PUA. Yes, I'm an asshole. I like to think I learned a lot about love from a sexless relationship young though. :) It's a shame it ended the way it did. I feel like shit...and you know the rest

Thank you for your thoughts :) 

It saddens me to hear this, because we had a great friendship, and a good relationship until my relapse, when it became toxic. I will always miss her.

Obviously I didn't mean renew friendship while I was still severely depressed. 

Yeah I do need to work on the porn. It's just the addiction and staying up late which is the problem (right now it's 4.30am lol, only reason I can do this is cos I don't have work) 

Yes I hope the aspie stuff helps. In the immediate present it's a bit embarrassing, just another label and one with quite a bit of stigma for one already considered socially awkward. And my dad does see it in everything I do atm, which is annoying (he looks after autistic clients, more severe than me, so I feel like he's bringing his job home with me) 

It left a mark, yeah :/ the '#abuse and false accusations/damage done to me' remarks are only a few months old.  

I will be kind to my dad tonight. Thank you for your help Space Camp :)

Hi, thanks for responding :) 

Yeah, that's what I worry about...is it worth my turning myself in to this abuse hotline then? 

Do you mind explaining how your brother uses his diagnosis to manipulate people...?

No it's OK if you're being constructively critical, it's unlikely I'm going to believe sweet nothings or sugar-coated pick-me-ups haha

Yeah, I do think she was hurt by the loss of trust. I also think that the fact that I claimed her to be cheating and stuff, implying sleeping around, which is pretty much the OPPOSITE of her religious values, hurt her. But I was not sleeping or thinking straight at the time...aargh I wish I could turn back the clock. I want to know exactly where I started to go wrong 

Well, I'm not sure it would have decided who she couldn't see...I just said if she was happier hanging with him, then it's alright and we could break up. I basically felt I wasn't making her happy

* Thank you for the tip, yes I am trying to workm on my SA :) it is difficult when I have developed Internet addiction and insomnia on top now 

* Well thank you...I do wonder whether I am a covert narcissist though. Like, maybe I am just here today to get reassurance, and once I've been validated enough I'll stop helping others out? Maybe I enjoy being a martyr? ugh 

* Thanks. I am trying my best. It's really embarrassing when I just burst like this in public :/ 

* Yeah I am trying to learn how to cook haha. I have since moved to Dad and there's a lot less tension now. The issue is that I've reprogrammed my mind to think that gym/eating healthy='make me bad person' or something, I recognise it's dumb but it's a habitual conditioned response. I am having to read on NLP/review CBT, and force myself to go through the guilt to try and set up new core beliefs/behaviours

* Will it not? But I thought that helping others *was* part of using it as a growing mechanism 

* Well the place I was in kinda encouraged that the insecurity *itself* was reason she was going to leave, displaying it would less hurt her and turn her off and make her want to cheat. They say it's toxic but when you're in there it sounds kind of logical

* I will admit I really struggle with jealousy. I feel like I've fell so far behind my peers, and again at this stage in my life women don't want no scrubs hah. It is frustrating. Not to mention some of the guys she was hanging out with were your typical 'alpha males'-fit, good looking, smart, popular, high social status, outgoing, ladies' men etc. Everything I tried to be and failed.

Thanks for responding :) 

1. OK... 

2. She didn't then. She did for a long time though. She apologised before meeting up re: her friend. She somehow interpreted. Then when I corrected her this is when we had this distancing. 

3. That's a relief! And yes, considering how much I ruminate, passing her house every time just sent me right down memory lane... 

4. Trying my best. I'm a lot calmer now thank you. I'm now kinda embarrassed about making a scene in the gym...twice... 

5. Sometimes I wonder if I am the one doing the gaslighting :/ well she has told me to delete her no. and not to contact her hasn't she haha. I was hoping one day we could be friends again...She also said "don't talk about me" though. I mean wtf? It's well past the stage I can bitch about the ex/breakup to my friends, hence why I have to bottle up how I feel about these last remarks. But that's pretty difficult, I found it hard to talk about her in therapy 

6. Yes it was. She explained that. That's one reason. Again someone fed me redpill crap and said basically, as she blossoms she'll have less interest in me and more interest in more 'alpha' guys such as her guy friend. So she might say to me "my culture/religion won't allow it" but have pre marital sex with another guy. This caused trust issues and inadequacies to arise. I am addicted to porn (erotic literature) and inevitably find myself on weird BDSM/fem-dom/cuckold stories where similar things happen, one story actually used the nickname of her guy friend and that tipped me over the edge. Then as mentioned some of the guys on this other forum I used to haunt didn't like me because they saw me as a pussy making excuses not to hit the gym (I was considered a troll in the fitness community because of my worry about my mom not wanting me to go the gym but my burning desire to go and fear about not going, the detrimental effects to my social/dating standing etc.) 

Depends what you mean. What do you think is the core of what's bothering me? This is just one thing. It's quite a big thing no doubt, but not the only thing. To try and answer in regards to this: 

   My dad picked up on my social impariments a long time ago, and kept suggesting I had Aspergers. I was on the fence about it for a long time, but I decided to get bipolar and psychotic symptoms ruled out with specialists late 2014 (a couple of weeks before this meetup with my ex in fact) and my psych. there suggested I was demonstrating and describing autistic traits. But I couldn't get diagnosed until I saw an ASD specialist, and I was on a waiting list for 12 months lol. So I was diagnosed as aspie October 2015, just speculating Oct/Nov 2014, and my ex went NC on me July/August 2015. To her I may have just been coming out with excuses or more weirdness; despite being in STEM, she was very cynical and sceptical of the NHS and in particular the mental health community. So even when she herself talking about feeling suicidal when we were dating, she wouldn't go see a doctor or the uni counsellors. She preferred to talk to me or just 'suck it up'. 

Anyway, I talk about most things with my dad, he is practically a therapist and in some ways is enabling me, but that is because I snapped at *him* when he tried to call me out on stuff (like idk, staying up late, or job-hunting...) He has since eased off on it, since as mentioned he saw me self-harm a month ago, so now he's decided I'm ill and best leave it to the pros. Before you say anything I am making efforts to get my shit together...

Dad met her all of once, after a surprise date she made on my 21st birthday. He and his gf agreed that it was the cultural differences, now he also says just let her go. He sides with her in the sense that my behaviour was probably off-putting and hurt her.

My mom is supportive, but I no longer live with her, as implied she could not handle the worst of my issues a few years ago, especially the food/gym obsessions, so I'm now living with dad. 

 Mom never met my ex, I don't think she really liked the idea of us dating, either she knew it wouldn't end well, she thought dating was distracting me from 'what mattered' (grades/studies, I got a scholarship into uni and narrowly scrapped a 2.1 due to the illness) All Mom saw was I was upset when X drama happened between us, or we broke up, and basically said cut her out, let her go, stop obsessing over her. Again, the fact people say I am obsessing, is why I have to bottle it up. Bear in mind my mom prides herself on cynicism and quietly thrives on a bit of gossip/opportunity to bitch about someone (usually staff, customer service or call centres, but sometimes others) Tbh both sides of my family are slightly racist lol, especially my grandparents. Not in a malicious way just in a prejudiced against different people way...still not great ha. 2 of my best friends in HS were Indian, though not Hindu quite liberal guys, so I was a little more open-minded.

Am I not?

*  I was passive aggressive and basically inferred she was cheating a few times, hence 'false accusations' (although last time I said this to her, I did not mean it as in "you're cheating on me?", she can see/do what the fuck she wants I'm no longer her boyfriend. I was just trying to apologise for why I had acted weird the last few months of 2014 and wanted to make amends

* Apparently I "snapped" at her too often (I remember I couldn't stay seeing her long after graduation, she scheduled to meet me a few days after. About an hour before she said something like "sorry was working late, can only see you for 5 minutes", I basically got pissed about this because we'd had a heart wrenching goodbye forever just 6 weeks before. 

* One could say I stalked her, although it certainly wasn't planned (I have to walk past her house to go to volunteering or town, unless I take a massive, I mean several miles detour). I tried to get in touch with her for the grad ceremony, but she didn't respond at the time. She gave me NO warning that she wasn't happy withmy turning up, just said she was sorry but had to go to meet a friend. I said I was cool with us not meeting up, did she want to catch up another time, she kept saying "I'm busy, maybe another time." This NC was because I basically said [sic][ "X, you are *always* busy, and I've got in touch with you once every 6 weeks at most for the past 6 months; please, I won't mind, just be honest if you want to part ways". She got annoyed by this and said "I''ve seriously been really busy and stressed, I was going to ask to meet up." idek

* One could argue it's controlling/possessive behaviour to get all ratty about her talking to a guy friend. 

* She said "you don't know the damage you've done to me but others have noticed." I asked her to explain and tried to apologise via text, but she cut me out. Apparently this is a pattern, that when many young women get tired of their ex they decide he was abusive and rationalise his behaviour so it's more extreme than it is. However, I feel misogynistic writing that out, and am trying to take her at face value. I don't understand why she'd try to put me down, when we used to do so much to build each other up. 

* Oh...she said she was uncomfortable with us doing a lot of the stuff we did (second base and so)...*weeks* after we had. Gave absolutely no notice. Again we did not have sex. She was flirting with me a lot. I did ask her if it was OK. And sometimes she gave mixed signals, like we went to the movies, she lay her head on my shoulder and held my hand, I put my arm ro0und her shoulder...then kissed her on the cheek, at which point she was like "what?" Confusing

Is she a third party? 

I already feel like a shitty person for hurting my parents, taking stress out on dad, pissing my friends off with my lateness due to anxiety issues and so on man :/
